preconditions.description: Both rows and columns must be integers.
Both rows and columns must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: The number of rows in the returned chessboard matches the input rows.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == columns for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each row in the returned chessboard has the number of columns specified by the input columns.

postconditions.expression: all(all(cell in ['O', 'X'] for cell in row) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the returned chessboard is either 'O' or 'X'.
The first cell of the first row in the returned chessboard is 'O'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i][j] == ('O' if (i + j) % 2 == 0 else 'X') for i in range(rows) for j in range(columns))
postconditions.description: Each cell in the returned chessboard alternates between 'O' and 'X' in a checkerboard pattern starting with 'O' in the top-left corner.
